purpose: Exact publisher-hosted prerequisite for the five-DLL central Windows package. Acquisition metadata is not installation or runtime qualification.
acquisition: User or administrator downloads directly from Microsoft; Gen2 runtime archive excludes installer and CRT DLL bytes.

terms.scope: Observed bundle-selected current terms provenance only; no assent, historical/future applicability or distribution entitlement inferred.

qualification.installer_signature_before_execution: Require actual Windows valid Microsoft signature observation, exact size and SHA256.
qualification.restart_policy: 3010 remains unqualified until an actual required restart and resulting state are verified; container recreation does not prove a Windows restart.
qualification.runtime_policy: Fresh offline process, no app-local CRT copies, exact installed AMD64 System32 DLL identities and actual loaded paths must be qualified separately.
